title: Proposed Cost of Government inquiry into West Maui Greenway
summary: On Nov. 12, the commission put off forming a temporary investigative group on the West Maui Greenway so the interim chair and the proposing commissioner can bring back a refined scope. The proposer said the project is further along than any other capital project he knows of but has not been carried out.

timeline.text: The item was put off so the interim chair and the proposing commissioner can bring back a refined scope.
The interim chair said he was uncomfortable forming the group before its scope is changed based on the discussion.
Another commissioner said the plan is very broad and the commission needs more meetings to understand it first.
He said the project is further along than any other capital project he knows of but has not been carried out.
A commissioner proposed a temporary investigative group, a small team that works on its own and reports back, to study the West Maui Greenway project.
